# T2 protocol (autonomous)

0. **Design**: the spec must contain `## Design` (components, boundaries, data flow, state/policy table, key decisions); `approve record`, `guard` and `gate` refuse a T2 spec without it.
1. **Spike** (scratch dir, disposable): list assumptions that would break the design if false; run each against the real runtime, covering every command shape. Record 3–5 lines in the spec "Assumptions". Simplify the execution environment first.
2. **Single source**: for IPC/API/state machines keep one machine-readable table; generate types/docs; test every cell, including illegal ones.
3. **AI review of the spec** (diff-only sub-agent): ambiguity, missing illegal cases, trust boundaries. Fix, then `approve record <feature> --by ai:<reviewer> --review "<summary>"`.
4. Implement with the T1 loop. Evidence lives in `.sdd/tdd.jsonl`; never paste it into chat.
5. **Parallel risk review** by axis, diff-only, findings in `.sdd/review.md`; delta re-review; stop after two clean rounds.
6. Human escalation only for `approval: human` triggers (policy loosening, destructive/irreversible, secrets, release). Present exact artifact paths, hash, residual risks.

## Test command config (`.sdd/config.json`)
`testCmd` placeholders: `{id}` `{idu}` (lower-case underscore) `{file}`. Autodetected: vitest, jest, pytest, go, cargo, else `node --test`. `checks`: `[{name, cmd:[...]}]` run by `gate` (typecheck/lint/test scripts autodetected).
